caption: the DinerTown daycare: babies to feed, rock and change - the side line's loudest customers.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: still sold on steam ($9.99) - one of the dash universe's surviving official doors. the archive routes below ride along for the original-era builds.

about: Diaper Dash, released on 12 august 2009, puts the loop in a daycare where the customers are babies. Feeding, rocking, changing and playing follow the chained-service rhythm, and a crying infant spreads impatience through the room faster than any diner guest ever did.
The build shipped in the same playfirst steam batch as the other 2009 dash games - produced with publisher credit to zemnott on the box - and that steam listing still sells the game today.
It stays on the buyable side of the shelf, with the archive routes riding along for the original-era build.
